en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet residential street lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century houses. On the left corner is a shop with an awning and signage; fenced front gardens border the sidewalk. A woman and a child walk down the pavement toward the distance. On the right, larger, more ornate buildings with decorative façades stand behind fences and trees. The scene is calm and largely empty of traffic, giving an early‑20th‑century European small‑town impression.
